title: CS daily scratchpad - QBR & renewals
content:
Daily scratchpad - 2026-06-01
Owner: Samuel Morris (CS)
Context: quick personal notes for QBR prep, renewal outreach, and support follow-ups. Working doc — will tidy for handoff.

MORNING PRIORITIES (top 3)
1) Acme Health QBR (Wed 2026-06-03, 10:00 PT) — finalize slide deck and runbook.
   - Slides: need cost breakdown slide (requested by Aisha). Pull token usage by route (api-key: acme-prod) for May.
   - Demos: schedule 15-min dry run with Jordan (Tue 6/2 9:30 PT).
   - Risks: intermittent latency spikes on dedicated cluster last month (link to incident SUP-2890). Need mitigation notes and escalation path on slide.
   - Action: export per-route latency and cost CSV, add to slide 4. Owner: Samuel (due EOD 6/1).

2) Renewals outreach: BlueWave and FinSight
   - BlueWave (renewal 2026-06-15, ARR $120k)
     - Last usage: steady but undercommit on embeddings. Renewal governance call scheduled 6/8.
     - Tasks: send renewal deck + proposed commit options (3 levels) — ask Sales to confirm discount band before sending.
     - Notes: CS rep: Priya; deal owner: Sales (Liam). Put renewal paper in Salesforce (opp: SF-9873).
   - FinSight (renewal 2026-06-10, ARR $45k)
     - Concern: one-off production regression last week led to elevated error rate; engineering patch deployed 5/28. Need success metrics to show improvement.
     - Action: collect post-patch error-rate by model and include in renewal email. Owner: Samuel (due 6/3).

3) Support follow-ups
   - SUP-2890 (Acme Health) — KV cache warmup issue causing first-token delays. Eng assigned (caseowner: Mei Chen). Waiting on kernel patch schedule.
     - Note: elevated during 9–11 AM PT only. Add suggestion to QBR: prefix caching + early warmup.
   - CS-412 (BlueWave) — invoice question resolved; need confirmation that PO received. Follow-up email template in Confluence (conf-1122).

MEETINGS / SCHEDULE
- 9:00 AM PT — Team standup (quick blockers)
- 10:30 AM PT — 30m with Aisha to review slides (confirm cost chart)
- 2:00 PM PT — Call with FinSight (prep: error-rate charts, patch timeline)
- Tue 6/2 9:30 PT — Dry run for Acme QBR with Jordan (booked)

NOTES / DATA SOURCES TO PULL
- Token usage by api_key (May) — run internal usage-export script (ops/playbooks/usage-export).
- Per-route latency: trace id samples for top 5 routes (use console -> traces -> route:generate-text).
- Billing: May invoice summary (finance Jira FIN-221).

OPEN QUESTIONS / TO-DOs
- Confirm whether we can offer a 10% early-renewal discount for BlueWave without Sales approval. (Pinged Liam, waiting)
- Get ETA on kernel patch for SUP-2890 (Mei Chen). If >1 week, prepare rollback/fallback plan for QBR.
- Add slide for "what to expect" (SLA + fallback) — need clear SLO and historical adherence numbers.

QUICK EMAIL DRAFTS (snippets)
- BlueWave renewal outreach:
  Subject: BlueWave renewal options + quick call
  Hi [Name],
  Quick note — per our usage trends, we put together 3 commit options tailored to your embeddings and generation workloads. Can we schedule a 20-min call next week to review?

- FinSight follow-up:
  Subject: Post-patch update and renewal prep
  Hi [Name],
  We pushed a fix for the production regression on 5/28 and have seen error-rate drop from 2.4% -> 0.3% in the last 48h (by model). Would love to share the metrics and next steps ahead of your renewal.

MISC NOTES (to self)
- Confirm whether QBR deck should include product roadmap slide — Aisha prefers to keep it light, focus on reliability and cost improvements.
- Save a copy of the final deck to Confluence under conf-4721 before sending.

TIMESTAMPED LOG (quick)
- 08:45 — pulled latency CSV, started cost slide
- 09:10 — standup, flagged SUP-2890 to eng
- 09:40 — working on BlueWave renewal options
- 11:20 — drafted FinSight email, waiting for error-rate export

END
